text: He called himself a god... until the sea closed over him.
Pharaoh chased Musa, alayhis salaam, into the parted sea. And the walls of water came crashing down.
As he drowned, he cried out: I believe there is no god except the One the Children of Israel believe in!
And Allah answered: Now? When before this you disobeyed?
Today We will save your body... so you become a sign for those who come after you.
